description: AAF International: Over 100 Years Helping Industry Achieve Cleaner, Safer and More Efficient Air AAF International helps companies around the world create safer working environments, protect their manufacturing processes and reduce the environmental impact associated with dust and particulate emissions. As part of the Daikin Industries Group, we combine the expertise of a specialist filtration company with the strength and resources of a global organisation renowned for its technological and industrial capabilities. Our business focuses on the design, manufacture and supply of dust collection and filtration systems for industrial applications. We develop solutions capable of handling a wide range of dusts generated throughout manufacturing processes, tailoring each system to the specific requirements of the facility. Our objective goes beyond regulatory compliance. We aim to improve worker safety, optimise process performance and contribute to more efficient industrial operations. With an international presence, manufacturing and development centres located across different regions of the world, and an extensive service and support network, AAF International supports customers throughout the entire lifecycle of their filtration systems. From initial engineering and technology selection through to maintenance and spare parts supply, we work to ensure reliable and consistent long-term performance. Our experience spans a broad range of industries, including chemicals, food and beverage, pharmaceuticals, automotive, metal processing, recycling, minerals, wood and paper, among many others. This diversity has enabled us to develop a deep understanding of the real challenges faced by modern industrial processes, as well as the specific characteristics of different dust types and emissions. AAF International's portfolio includes cartridge and baghouse dust collectors, wet collectors, specialised filtration systems, and a comprehensive range of services and consumables. Every solution is designed to deliver high levels of performance, durability and energy efficiency, helping customers reduce operating costs and maximise plant availability. Innovation, safety and customer proximity are at the heart of the way we work. We believe that every industrial application is unique and that the best solutions come from a thorough understanding of the process, operational objectives and specific challenges of each customer. By combining technical expertise, engineering capability and a long-term perspective, we deliver solutions that create tangible value from day one.

Berthold: Reliable Measurement Solutions for Your Industrial Processes A specialist in industrial measurement and detection technologies, Berthold helps plant operators monitor, optimise and safeguard their processes. Our expertise is based on in-depth knowledge of several areas of physics—including microwave, near-infrared, capacitive, electrostatic and radiometric technologies—combined with advanced skills in electronics and software. For industries handling powders, granules, pellets, grains and other bulk materials, Berthold offers a comprehensive range of online, real-time measurement solutions: • moisture measurement; • particle size measurement; • colour measurement; • solid mass flow monitoring and measurement; • level measurement and high/low level detection; • density, concentration and dry matter measurement; • filter monitoring and bag-break detection; • fire prevention through the detection and suppression of hot spots, sparks and incipient flames. Our equipment can be integrated into the main conveying, handling and storage systems, including belt, screw, chain and vibrating conveyors, pneumatic conveying lines, free-fall applications, chutes, hoppers, silos, tanks and pipelines. Depending on the application and product characteristics, our teams select the most suitable technology to provide accurate, stable and representative measurements. Non-contact and non-intrusive solutions are among Berthold’s key areas of expertise. Installed outside the equipment, the sensors are not directly exposed to the product, abrasion or build-up. They remain reliable in demanding industrial environments involving dust, high temperatures, vibration, corrosive or alkaline products, and materials that are difficult to measure. They are easy to retrofit to existing processes and require little maintenance. Our systems help manufacturers improve product quality, optimise dosing and yields, reduce material and energy losses, prevent malfunctions and increase plant availability. Berthold France supports customers throughout every stage of their project: feasibility studies, technology selection, installation, commissioning, calibration, operator training and maintenance. Our specialist technicians work in France and internationally and hold the required qualifications to operate on high-risk industrial sites. Used in the food and animal feed, chemical, mining and minerals, metal, building materials, energy, biomass, wood, paper, environmental and recycling industries, Berthold solutions meet both standard measurement needs and the most complex process challenges.

EUROTECH-JANODET designs, manufactures and integrates dosing, weighing and packaging equipment for bulk solids. Its offering combines JANODET’s expertise in dosing and weighing with EUROTECH’s capabilities in bagging and palletising. Applications span food processing, animal nutrition, seeds, fertilisers, chemicals, minerals and wood products. Equipment selection considers particle size distribution, bulk density, flow characteristics and product fragility, alongside packaging specifications. The technical scope includes net and gross weighing, bagging with pre-made bags or tubular film, big bag filling, sewing or heat sealing, conveying, palletising and stretch wrapping. Checkweighing, labelling and traceability complete the installation as required. Weighing configurations suitable for trade use are also available. Projects range from standalone machines to complete lines and upgrades to existing installations. Engineering addresses dosing accuracy, overall line throughput, format changeovers and interfaces between machines. Layout design accounts for bag and pallet flows, maintenance access and workstation ergonomics. EUROTECH-JANODET’s development within the MACHINEXT Group broadens the expertise available in automation, robotics and machine vision. These complementary capabilities support projects incorporating additional handling, inspection and equipment synchronisation functions. Current development work focuses on bagging systems supporting multiple closure methods, automated handling and machine vision inspection. This work aims to improve transfer reliability, reduce manual intervention and accommodate a wider range of products and formats. Working relationships with customers are built on direct dialogue between engineering, production and maintenance teams. Support extends from initial studies through commissioning and throughout equipment operation, including technical assistance, maintenance, spare parts and modifications. Mechanical robustness, accuracy and ease of maintenance remain core design criteria.

INDUSTRIAL MIXING SOLUTIONS FOR POWDERS, GRANULES AND BULK MATERIALS Looking for a reliable mixing solution for powders, granules, pastes or difficult-flowing bulk materials? Heilig Mixing Technology develops and manufactures industrial mixers and complete mixing systems tailored to your product, process and production requirements. Our solutions are designed for high mixing quality, reliable operation, efficient processing and long service life. V-MIX CONICAL MIXER The V-mix combines a rotating mixing screw, a moving swing arm and gravity to achieve a highly homogeneous mixture while treating the product gently. Its conical design enables efficient mixing, low energy consumption and almost complete product discharge. With capacities up to 75,000 litres, the V-mix can be configured for a wide range of processes. Options include liquid addition, coating, heating, cooling, vacuum and pressure operation, as well as solutions for ATEX environments. The V-mix is used across industries including food, feed, chemicals, minerals, plastics, pharmaceuticals and battery materials. CENTRAL BALANCE MIXER – CBM For more intensive mixing and processing applications, Heilig Mixing Technology offers the Central Balance Mixer. The CBM is designed for fast and effective mixing and can also be used for processes such as homogenising, heating and cooling. Each CBM is configured around the properties of the raw materials, the production process and the required final product. FROM MIXER TO COMPLETE PROCESS SOLUTION A successful mixing process involves more than the mixer itself. Heilig Mixing Technology can integrate equipment such as dosing systems, conveyors, screens, hoppers, silos and control systems into one complete solution. From a stand-alone mixer to a fully integrated turnkey installation, our engineers develop the system around your production process. SERVICE, OVERHAUL AND MODIFICATION Already operating a conical mixer? We also provide maintenance, repairs, modifications, overhauls and spare parts for existing mixing installations. Our service is available for Heilig Mixing Technology equipment as well as conical mixers from other manufacturers, including Nauta mixers. Upgrading an existing mixer can improve reliability, performance and service life without the need to replace the complete installation. LET’S DISCUSS YOUR MIXING CHALLENGE Whether you need to improve mixing quality, increase process efficiency, handle a difficult product or modernise an existing mixer, our engineers can help you find the right solution. Meet Heilig Mixing Technology at Vrac Tech and discuss your mixing process with our specialists.

Since 1961, TRANSITUBE has been designing and manufacturing flexible mechanical conveying solutions for transferring, metering and distributing powders, granules and other bulk solids. Our technology uses a reinforced flexible spiral rotating inside a tube, enabling products to be conveyed along horizontal, inclined, vertical or curved routes. Compact and adaptable, the TRANSITUBE system can be integrated into both new installations and existing processes, particularly where layout, space or accessibility constraints make conventional solutions difficult to implement. Our equipment is used across a wide range of industrial sectors, including chemicals and fine chemicals, minerals, construction materials, plastics, environmental applications, foundries, powder processing and non-food agricultural industries. It can be configured to handle products with highly diverse characteristics, including fine powders, bridging or cohesive materials, granules, abrasive substances and products with poor flow properties. TRANSITUBE solutions include: * extraction from hoppers, silos, bag-emptying stations or big-bag discharging stations; * flexible mechanical conveying; * volumetric dosing; * vertical elevation; * distribution to one or more discharge points; * feeding of mixers, reactors, vessels, packaging lines and production equipment. The absence of intermediate bearings within the conveying line helps simplify installation and maintenance. As a mechanical conveying system, it requires neither conveying air nor a dedicated filtration system. Depending on the application, our equipment can also be designed to meet the requirements applicable to potentially explosive atmospheres and ATEX environments. Each project is individually assessed, taking into account the product characteristics, required throughput, conveying distance, elevation, route, operating conditions and process requirements. This approach enables us to propose a suitable configuration, ranging from a standalone unit to a fully integrated installation. With TRANSITUBE, manufacturers benefit from proven, flexible and customisable technology designed to transfer their materials efficiently while adapting to the practical realities of their production processes.
